title: AI vs. Human Judgment of Content Moderation: LLM-as-a-Judge and Ethics-Based Response Refusals
reasoning: The paper investigates 'moderation bias' in LLM-as-a-Judge frameworks by specifically analyzing how they evaluate 'ethical refusals'—responses where an AI declines a prompt due to normative, moral, or safety concerns. It compares these evaluations to human judgments to identify divergences in ethical alignment and normative assumptions.
